detail.longDescription: I am looking for a way to run a task starting at a certain time and then repeating every X amount of time afterwards for my bot. For example, run a function at Sunday 7:00pm and then every week afterwards. As it stands I have the current code and am getting the following error shown below. It would be preferable to use the same libraries and have it be async so it isn't blocking other bot functions. import asyncio from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta import pytz days = { "Monday": 0, "Tuesday": 1, "Wednesday": 2, "Thursday": 3, "Friday": 4, "Saturday": 5, "Sunday": 6, } def delay_until(day: str, hour: int): if ( day.capitalize() not in days or day.capitalize() != "Tomorrow" or hour < 0 or hour > 24 ): return "Invalid date provided" # Get the next day coming up, i.e. the next Monday today = datetime.now(tz=pytz.utc).date() if day.capitalize() == "Tomorrow": target_day = today + timedelta(days=1) else: target_day = today + timedelta( days=(days[day.capitalize()] - today.weekday()) % 7 ) # Add the hours onto the date to make the datetime full_datetime: datetime = datetime( year=target_day.year, month=target_day.month, day=target_day.day, hour=hour, tzinfo=pytz.utc, ) # Get the time from the target datetime to now in seconds delta = full_datetime - datetime.now(tz=pytz.utc) delay: float = delta.total_seconds() return delay # Function to schedule a task to run after a given delay and time to loop async def schedule(delay: float, loop_time: float, function, *args, **kwargs): await asyncio.sleep(delay) while True: await asyncio.gather(function(*args, **kwargs), asyncio.sleep(loop_time)) def time_from_string(time: int, unit: str): match unit: case "week": return time * 604800 case "day": return time * 86400 def demo_fx(): print("hello world") async def sample_task(): await schedule( delay=delay_until("Sunday", 21), loop_time=time_from_string(1, "week"), function=demo_fx(), ) print(asyncio.run(sample_task())) Output: hello world Traceback (most recent call last): File "/home/bptsoum/Programming/Tinkering/scrap.py", line 153, in <module> print(asyncio.run(sample_task())) ~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.14/asyncio/runners.py", line 205, in run return runner.run(main) ~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.14/asyncio/runners.py", line 128, in run return self._loop.run_until_complete(task) ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^ File "/usr/lib/python3.14/asyncio/base_events.py", line 720, in run_until_complete return future.result() ~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^ File "/home/bptsoum/Programming/Tinkering/scrap.py", line 147, in sample_task await schedule( ...<3 lines>... ) File "/home/bptsoum/Programming/Tinkering/scrap.py", line 131, in schedule await asyncio.sleep(delay) File "/usr/lib/python3.14/asyncio/tasks.py", line 692, in sleep if delay <= 0: ^^^^^^^^^^ TypeError: '<=' not supported between instances of 'str' and 'int'
